The best JoinBrands alternative depends on what you actually want: more UGC content, or TikTok Shop sales. JoinBrands is a multi-platform UGC marketplace, so if you want content there are other marketplaces, but if what you really need is creators driving TikTok Shop GMV, the better alternative is a TikTok Shop affiliate tool or a managed program. Diagnose the goal first, because these solve different problems.

Before you pick, get the goal straight, because content and sales are run very differently. One seller described what actually drives TikTok Shop sales as a system: "1 to 3 hero products, a strong TikTok-exclusive offer, competitive creator commissions, consistent sample outreach, clear hooks, not rigid scripts" (@jordantwestecom on X). A UGC marketplace produces clips; it does not run that loop.

If you want TikTok Shop sales

JoinBrands gives you content and leaves the selling to you. If your goal is GMV, you want a TikTok-Shop-native option:

  • Tokgency (managed): a TikTok-only agency that recruits creators, runs the affiliate program, and owns GMV. Best when you want sales, not just footage. See Tokgency vs JoinBrands.
  • Reacher, Euka, Cruva (software): affiliate platforms where creators sell your product for commission. Best if you have an operator to run them.

If you want UGC content

If you genuinely need content for your own ads and listings, the alternatives are other UGC platforms and marketplaces. These compete with JoinBrands on the same job: sourcing creator-made video you own and use yourself.

Side by side

Option Type Deliverable Best for
Tokgency Managed agency GMV TikTok Shop sales
Reacher / Euka / Cruva Affiliate software GMV Sales, if you operate it
Other UGC marketplaces Marketplace Content Ad/listing footage

How to choose

  • You want sales on TikTok Shop: Tokgency or an affiliate tool.
  • You want content for your own ads: another UGC marketplace.
  • You want both: a managed program for GMV plus a marketplace for creative.

The takeaway

JoinBrands sells content; whether its best alternative is another marketplace or a sales-focused affiliate option comes down to your goal. If you were hoping a UGC marketplace would drive TikTok Shop sales, the real fix is a TikTok Shop program, not a different marketplace.

Want creators who sell, not just film? Book a call, or find TikTok Shop sellers.
